quote: Woman is born free and remains equal to man in rights.
source: Olympe de Gouges, Declaration of the Rights of Woman and of the Female Citizen, Article I (trans. Lynn Hunt, 1996)

evidence.where: The Liberty, Equality, Fraternity archive at George Mason University, which prints Hunt translation of the Declaration with her credit line.
evidence.edition: Lynn Hunt, trans. and ed., The French Revolution and Human Rights: A Brief Documentary History (Bedford/St. Martin, 1996), pp. 124 to 129

reason: Article I in Hunt translation reads exactly as proposed, followed by a second sentence on social distinctions that the quotation does not take. The Bedford page range in the proposal matches the credit line printed with the document.
